script_text: Hold your breath, Aquarius—Uranus is about to crack open your sky. This is a real cosmic crossroads, not generic noise. Mars in Leo forms a tense square to your ruling planet, Uranus retrograde in Taurus, sparking friction between your 7th House of Partnerships and your 4th House of Home. At the same time, Mercury in Scorpio squares your Sun in your 10th House of Career, so expect mixed messages at work. But Venus in Libra trines your Air-sign Sun, bringing harmony to romance and social circles. If you're taken, watch for a partner demanding more freedom than you can give. If single, you'll attract someone through travel or shared ideals. Financially, avoid joint investments—your 8th House is under pressure. Trust a sudden intuitive hit about money instead. Warning: do not sign a lease or contract under this Mars-Uranus square. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
